text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...Pins and needles.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(It's my body tingling with an entirely
new sort of
fever. I know that much.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (It's excitement and elation.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Awe at encountering strong new
competitors.
And I'm thankful that they
put everything they
had into our race
today.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure that... my limits are further
still...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Your performance today... was
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Let's have another great race next time,
too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I have returned.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Although I'm frustrated that victory
eluded
my grasp, I have learned
something more
valuable.
choice_data_list: 手応えはあったみたいだな
手応えはあったみたいだね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...That their prowess is beyond anything I

imagined. As such, I'm truly delighted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The existence of such exceptional,

boundary-pushing racers has shown
me—as
clearly as the dawn light—that
my limits do not lie
here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can continue to be their
dear rival
and goal to overcome...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The limits my body can overcome will
remain
endless, and both the radiance I
emit and the trail
of light I leave will
shine on into eternity!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That is what I believe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when challenging stronger
opponents
head-on, Mejiro Ardan's
resolve holds firm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, it looks like she's discovered just
what
she's capable of, and it's set her
fighting spirit
aflame!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Do you think I'll be able to reach those
heights
someday? And emit a light more
dazzling than
theirs?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Hearing you say that with such
confidence
is greatly encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her classic year draws to a close, I bet
the
upcoming clashes against her rivals
will become
even more intense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It'd probably be best to give ourselves
some time
to build up Mejiro Ardan's
skills before running
another goal race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the traditional route? That race
determines
the finest medium-distance
runner of the spring,
doesn't it?
choice_data_list: 次は、『大阪杯』を目指そう

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I imagine it'll be another gathering of
brilliant
lights.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Indeed.
choice_data_list: 競うのが今から楽しみだな
競うのが今から楽しみだね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's go back right away and review
today's
events. I wish to look over
Tamamo and Oguri's
performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, an ecstatic Mejiro Ardan and I
make our
way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, unbeknownst to us...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: This year's autumn Tenno Sho has turned out to be another incredible race! The venue is still buzzing with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan's getting stronger and stronger...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: While I'm just...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...It's okay. I can get stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (No. I have to get stronger...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...In order to become a worthy rival to
Chiyono
O when she returns to the races
someday!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai—there, I shall put on an
even
more radiant performance!
